div.div:
Solid entity links: declared PG FK / Mongo ORM. Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.
Solid Mongo associations are ORM relations, not SQL foreign-key constraints. ConversationMember is a parallel membership projection; participantIds remains a canonical contract.
User IDs refer to User Service. No RagTrace entity exists in the current local AI schema; Langfuse holds monitoring snapshots.
Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists.
